title: Walk Initialization Correctness
statement: Let $E,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{orc}$ be an oracle on four indices and finite Boolean words, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $Q$ be a proposition. Let $\sigma$ be a state whose registers are all at most $B$, and suppose $\sigma.K+1\le B$. Write $w_b=\sigma.u$ and $t_b=\sigma.i$ when $b$ is true, and $w_b=\sigma.v$ and $t_b=\sigma.i1$ otherwise. If membership of $t_b$ in the set of codes reachable from some initial code $u<\sigma.K$ by a walk of at most $\sigma.K$ steps implies that the machine started at its walk-entry state with $cur=stp=g=0$ terminates within register bound $B$ and accepts exactly when $Q$ holds, then the machine started at its walk-initialization state with register values $\sigma$ terminates within that bound and accepts exactly when $t_b$ is so reachable and $Q$ holds. Here initial codes and steps are determined by the oracle's initial-code and transition queries, respectively, and each intermediate code in the walk is less than $\sigma.K$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{orc}$ is an oracle on four indices and Boolean words
Every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
The stated implication from reachability to the semantics at the walk-entry state

Let $E,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\{0,1\}^* $ be an oracle,
let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $\sigma$ be a machine state. Write $K,s$ for its
code bound and parameter, and write $w_b$ and $t_b$ for its two state fields selected by
$b\in\{0,1\}$. Let $\mathrm{Mem}(L,t)$ mean that some $u<K$ satisfies the initial oracle
query at $u$ and is connected to $t$ by at most $L$ steps, each step being an
oracle-accepted transition between codes less than $K$. Suppose every register of
$\sigma$ is at most $B$, and $K+1\le B$. If, whenever $\mathrm{Mem}(w_b,t_b)$ holds, the
machine started at its walk-entry control state with the same other parameters and with
its current code, step count, and guess registers all zero has semantics $Q$, then the
machine started at its walk-initialization control state in state $\sigma$ has semantics
$\mathrm{Mem}(w_b,t_b)\land Q$.
